summary: Brookfield Property Partners L.P., via its indirect subsidiary Brookfield Property Finance ULC, filed an Eighth Supplemental Indenture to issue 5.55% Medium Term Notes (unsecured), Series 8, due June 19, 2031, under an indenture dated July 3, 2018 with Computershare Trust Company of Canada as trustee. This is a routine debt financing transaction—a plain-vanilla medium-term note issuance with standard change-of-control covenants, interest payment terms, and redemption provisions. There is no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or other special-situation element. No deal terms apply. The filing is a standard Form 6-K reporting a supplemental indenture.
